observedFailure: An uncounted exam segment hit the 240-second outer watchdog while awaiting the next card. The first missed-card source visit had completed.
cause: The selector matched a shared secondary-button style and selected the left Exit action instead of the right Continue action; WXML confirms both share this class.
evidenceKind: Observed tool error, preserved original script and subsequent native-state/recovery observations; the earlier raw failed tool JSON was replaced during retry and is not represented as an immutable raw response.
recovery: Canonical original six-key state restored and exact original fingerprint verified before continuation.
fix: Right-hand action scope plus text/uniqueness checks; finite internal waits and guarded body deadline allow cleanup before outer watchdog.
